senses.gloss: , read אֱרַקְלִיּוֹס pr. n. m. Heraclius, the surname of Maximianus, the associate emperor of Diocletian.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:5:1">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ</cite> top <he>אנא דיקל׳ וכ׳</he> I, Diocletian the king, have instituted the annual fair of Tyre in honor of the genius of my brother Heraclius (Heracles).
